More About Me

Curious about people,
drawn to the why

I have always been drawn to stories. Between you and me, my guilty pleasure is Young Adult fiction. What draws me in is how easy of a read it is, how digestible and often times, predictable the story is. In many ways, I feel the same way about good design. It should be intuitive, digestible and grounded in its user’s existing mental models.

As a Sociology graduate, asking questions is my bread and butter. It trained me to read cause and effect — not just at an individual level, but also across institutions, norms and structures that shape how people make decisions. That perspective has shaped the way I think about design too.

Like a good book, good design can still be interpreted differently by different people. The challenge is making sense of those different perspectives while still arriving at the most optimal decision.
